acceptanceCriteria: Multi-line secret forms (PEM blocks, a token split by a newline) are redacted in the salvage and carry-over records, with synthetic fixtures
The ATR failure-mode paragraph is updated to the new bound
body: The screen reused by V1-1763 hard-stop salvage and the V1-1782 carry-over (PR #1126) redacts secrets only within single lines. Expected: a credential that a model's final message wraps across lines (e.g. a long token broken by a newline, or a PEM block) is redacted before it is stored or injected into the next prompt. Actual: only whole-line matches are screened; documented as a failure mode in the ATR spec. Suspected-defect class: confirmed limitation, not observed in the wild.
